<title id="_2937044f-d89f-c6ce-d7a2-7719fae99482">5. Progress UX (locked 2026-07-26)</title>
<p id="_656ab1a8-eaa8-7068-8048-e0363fae1bd3">When the loader fetches a runtime or image, the user SEES the work and the benefit. Rules:</p>

<ul id="_bc0df9df-9e41-69d7-4bdc-4d1fe8943413"> <li> <p id="_a20a0a13-0c49-7096-6eba-a0aa70187e85"> <strong>TTY-only:</strong> full progress rendering iff stderr is a TTY and <tt>TERM != dumb</tt>; otherwise exactly two single lines (start + done), CI/ log-safe. Opt-outs:  <tt>NO_COLOR</tt>, <tt>TEBAKO_NO_PROGRESS=1</tt>, and the package's baked  <tt>TPKG_FLAG_QUIET_NOTICES</tt> (bit 3 — spec 23 §14).</p>
